# E0428: a view reads what it must write

A view that the code writes through is made writable, with `view.into(inout xs, …)`.

- Rule: [`projections.writable-bindings`](../../reference/13-modes.md#projections.writable-bindings)
- Reported at: the view given to the `var` binding, yielded or returned.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0428:5
use std.view

fn main() / io {
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  var head = view.View.of(xs, 0, 2)
  head[0] = 9
  print("{head}")
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.view

fn main() / io {
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  var head = view.into(inout xs, 0, 2)
  head[0] = 9
  print("{head}")
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0428_a_view_reads_what_it_must_write.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0428_a_view_reads_what_it_must_write.lt):

```text
── A VIEW READS WHAT IT MUST WRITE ── E0428_a_view_reads_what_it_must_write.lt:5:14  [E0428]

This view reads `xs`, which `head` must write:

  5 │   var head = view.View.of(xs, 0, 2)
    │              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A view that the code writes through is made writable, with `view.into(inout xs,
…)`.

To fix it, make it with `view.into(inout xs, …)`:

  5 │   var head = view.into(inout xs, 0, 2)
    │              ~~~~~~~~~~++++++
```
